candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if the residual density required to pass the function screen exceeds independent Q4 bytes.
candidates.mechanism: Generated decoder + sparse residual on capability-sensitive experts. The residual is the expert's identity.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Decode tile, add sparse residual, fuse SwiGLU. No densify.
candidates.scar_distance: Not unchanged archetype (residual changes per expert).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if ||V @ x_{L+1} - adapter(z_L)|| is not smaller than ||V @ x_{L+1}|| on a real residual stream (then reuse is a no-op). Do not score by W cosine across layers (dead tying metric).
candidates.mechanism: cross-layer reused transforms: reuse a transform of the residual stream (V_L @ x_L) as an initialization for layer L+1, with a small adapter, instead of independently projecting at every layer.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Keep z_L = V @ x_L. At L+1 compute z_{L+1} = z_L + V @ Δ (or a small adapter on z_L). Token path uses z, never W. V may be per-block (storage SB9) or per-layer with reuse of the product.
candidates.scar_distance: Not same-index cross-layer weight tying. Not an unchanged archetype copied across layers.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Identity check: shared-U expand-then-sum vs reduce-then-expand must match at 0.0 residual (planted). Kill the candidate if a real organ requires per-expert U to meet the function screen (then the identity does not apply).
candidates.mechanism: latent weighted reduction: apply router weights in a small latent and reduce there, instead of weighting full d_model outputs.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Each selected expert writes an r-vector. Weighted sum in r. One U @ u. Exact when U is shared. No dense down_proj.
candidates.scar_distance: Not expert merging (all selected experts still run). Not mean subtraction.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Planted shared-U identity (must be exact). Then one-layer down function screen vs per-expert U. Kill if per-expert U is required.
candidates.mechanism: one output expansion: a single shared expansion of a reduced intermediate, rather than k independent down_proj GEMVs.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind one U. Consume the reduced latent. One GEMV to d_model. Never k packed down_proj payloads applied independently unless the function screen forbids sharing U.
candidates.scar_distance: Not a trivial shared basis of whole W. Not same-index tying.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Do not rerun the B-sweep of ACCELERATOR_EXPERT_BATCH as if it were new. Falsify the FUSED remainder: a kernel that keeps x resident and reads packed rows vs the existing per-expert qwen80_routed_expert_wave_gate_up dispatches, on the same packed payload, under a protected lease (later lane). Kill if the fused wave matches the independent-dispatch complete-token within noise.
candidates.mechanism: one hidden vector entering many experts: keep x register/SRAM resident and stream selected expert rows against it in one wave, fused with SiLU(gate)*up. Not a stacked dense table of independent W_e.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Load x once into threadgroup memory. Each threadgroup owns an intermediate row of a selected expert's packed gate/up and dots against resident x. Packed values are consumed in-register. No dense W_e, no stacked dense table.
candidates.scar_distance: Not naive expert-table batching (already measured). Not a trivial shared basis (no shared W).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if a shared V for gate+up fails the function screen on gate (dominant_failure_organ historically). The fused-but-unshared kernel is the control, not a missing fusion.
candidates.mechanism: shared projections across organs: hoist a common transform of x that both gate and up (and possibly the shared expert) can reuse, instead of two independent input projections per expert.
candidates.native_execution_concept: One V @ x. Skinny gate core and skinny up core against z, fused SiLU product. Independent per-organ paths remain legal for the sensitive organ (gate). No densified W_gate or W_up.
candidates.scar_distance: Not already-built fused gate-up (that still uses two matrices). Not a trivial shared basis of the whole expert.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if K is large enough to become a gather LUT (dead lever: learned codebook LUT). Kill if the kernel writes or caches a dense W (NS-018: caching decoded W restores the footprint the representation exists to remove). Kill if the codebook is raw-weight PQ at ~1 BPW (dead family). A planted tiny shared CB plus fused FMA must beat per-expert unpack on a synthetic packed payload before any specimen is touched.
candidates.mechanism: shared representation decode: a tiny shared codebook / scale family lives in registers; per-expert payloads are indices consumed fused with the matvec. Decode is not a per-expert prologue that writes dense W.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Codebook in registers (K tiny). Fused FMA of codebook entries with x. No densify-then-GEMM. Organ-specific codebooks allowed.
candidates.scar_distance: Not NS-010 unconditioned shared codebook on raw routed-expert weights. Not entropy-coded Lloyd indices. Not NS-018 cache-decoded-W. Not NNS-018 single-family-across-organs (organ-specific tiny CBs are allowed).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Same cheapest falsifier as shared input transforms (uncoded V, real X). Kill on function before claiming a compute win. A protected complete-token comparison is a later lane.
candidates.mechanism: shared xB transform with small expert-specific transforms: z = x @ B once; y_e = z @ C_e. Compute dual of shared input / common right.
candidates.native_execution_concept: One GEMV z = B @ x in SRAM. Selected C_e stream against z. No W_e = C_e B. Gate and up may share the same z.
candidates.scar_distance: Not trivial shared basis (B is a transform of x, not a shared W). Not ACCELERATOR_EXPERT_BATCH stacking of independent W_e.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if island labels derived from a capability screen do not reduce per-island joint-SVD null-gap vs the global null (then the partition is cosmetic). Kill if the partition is used to justify a single codec family across organs (NNS-018).
candidates.mechanism: capability-sensitive expert islands: partition the bank by capability / organ sensitivity (gate vs down, layer-band, tool vs language), and share structure only inside an island. Islands may use different mechanisms.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Tag experts/organs with an island id. Each island binds its own shared factors and native path (e.g. down island uses shared U, gate island stays independent or uses a milder skinny). The kernel dispatches per island; it does not densify a mixed W.
candidates.scar_distance: Not raw global similarity (partitioned on purpose). Not a single unconditioned shared basis across the bank.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if the K that beats the orthogonal null is ~E (then clustering is a rename of independent experts). Kill if the method reconstructs a held-out expert from cluster mates (that is dead expert-merging, atlas expert_merging_omitted_from_survivors / NNS-023).
candidates.mechanism: clustered subspaces: partition experts into K << E clusters; each cluster shares a left or right factor; members keep a skinny residual. All experts remain present.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind K shared factors and a cluster-id table (log2 K bits/expert). Selected expert e in cluster k uses V_k @ x then C_e. Gather V_k by cluster id, not by reconstructing W_e.
candidates.scar_distance: Not raw global similarity (K spaces, not one). Not expert merging (every expert is stored; no omitted-expert reconstruction). Not an unchanged archetype (cluster factor plus member residual).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Instrument first on a planted U_shared @ C_e stack (must recover shared energy) and an orthogonal control (must not). Then, at a later funnel stage that owns a specimen, one layer / one organ / 8 experts: joint SVD of stacked W_e W_e^T energy in top-r. Kill if top-r energy is indistinguishable from the orthogonal null. Do not flatten-and-cosine. Do not fit the full bank in this lane.
candidates.mechanism: common left subspaces: share an output-side factor U across experts; keep expert-specific right factors C_e. Algebra y = U @ (C_e @ x) without forming W_e = U @ C_e.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind one U[d_model, r] per layer-organ and gathered C_e[r, d_in] for the selected experts. Compute z_e = C_e @ x (skinny), then y = U @ sum_e w_e z_e (or U @ z_e per expert if U is only partly shared). Never write W_e into DRAM.
candidates.scar_distance: Not raw global similarity (does not flatten W or use pairwise cosine). Not a trivial shared basis (one-sided, not U_shared @ V_shared for all experts).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Planted shared-V stack vs orthogonal control (instrument). Then one-layer joint SVD of stacked W_e^T W_e. Kill if top-r energy matches the orthogonal null at the r the byte plan needs. Pairwise overlap of two experts is not this test.
candidates.mechanism: common right subspaces: share an input-side factor V across experts in WEIGHT space of the stacked bank; expert-specific left cores C_e. Algebra y_e = C_e @ (V @ x).
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind one V[r, d_in] and gathered C_e[d_out, r]. Compute z = V @ x once per organ (or once per layer if gate/up share V), then y_e = C_e @ z. Never form W_e = C_e @ V.
candidates.scar_distance: Not trivial shared basis (one-sided joint factor of the stack, not one unconditioned basis plus nf4 residual on raw W). Not activation-PCA (that is shared_input_transforms).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if ||residual_e|| / ||expert_e|| is ~1 on the named shared_op (mean-expert already showed this). The falsifier must name the shared_op; 'the mean' is not an allowed shared_op. Do not merge omitted experts from residuals (NNS-023).
candidates.mechanism: conditional residuals: y = shared_op(x) + residual_e(x), where shared_op is a learned or architecture-native shared operator (not the mean expert) and residual_e is skinny / sparse / gated.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Compute y_shared = shared_op(x) once. Selected experts add R_e @ z (skinny) or a sparse residual. Sum. Never form W_e = W_shared + R_e as a dense matrix.
candidates.scar_distance: Not shared-mean subtraction (explicitly forbidden as shared_op). Not expert merging. Not an unchanged archetype.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if residual energy of predicted factors is ~1 (then prediction is a no-op, matching the tying control). The test is on factors, not on flattened W. Do not reopen same-index W tying.
candidates.mechanism: cross-layer expert prediction: predict layer L+1's expert factors from layer L's (same index or learned map); store only the residual of that prediction. Weights are not tied.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind predictors P that map C_e,L -> C_e,L+1_hat as a small linear map on factors. Token path uses the residual-corrected factors already in the same skinny buffers. No dense W_L or W_{L+1}.
candidates.scar_distance: Not same-index cross-layer weight tying (atlas / NNS-024). The stored object is a factor residual, not tied W.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if the K needed to hit a planted reconstruction is so large the dictionary plus codes exceed independent coding. Kill if atoms are applied by densifying W_e. Do not entropy-code Lloyd indices as the byte win (atlas entropy_coded_pq_indices).
candidates.mechanism: dictionary families: a shared dictionary of linear atoms; each expert is a sparse combination of those atoms, executed as a sum of gathered low-rank factors.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Keep dictionary atoms as GEMM factors in registers/SRAM (tiny K). Expert e holds sparse indices and scales. y_e = sum_{k in supp(e)} s_{e,k} * (atom_k @ x). Lookup-free FMA. Never densify W_e from the atom sum. Large LUT gathers are a recorded dead lever.
candidates.scar_distance: Not NS-010 unconditioned shared codebook on raw routed-expert weights. Not a single unchanged template. Not SB6-large-LUT.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if ||G(h_e) - target_factors|| requires h_e or G large enough that embeddings+G exceed independent skinny factors. Kill if G emits dense W. Do not score this by pairwise cosine of W.
candidates.mechanism: expert embeddings / generators: each expert is a small embedding h_e; a shared generator G maps h_e to the factors a kernel consumes (cores, codes, or skinny maps), not to a dense W_e.
candidates.native_execution_concept: At bind time, G(h_e) emits C_e (or sparse codes) into the same buffers the small-core / dictionary kernel already consumes. The token path never calls G if cores are materialized as skinny factors; G is a storage generator, not a per-token network. Never emit dense W_e from G.
candidates.scar_distance: Not NNS-024 procedural generated expert bases on orthogonal experts: this does not assume similarity and does not emit W. Not an unchanged archetype (h_e differs; G is shared).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Planted sandwich recovers C_e energy; orthogonal W_e must force r ≈ min(d_out, d_in) to fit. Kill if the r that beats independent coding is not small enough to cut bytes after storing U and V once.
candidates.mechanism: expert-specific small cores: W_e ≈ U @ C_e @ V with C_e a small r x r (or r x s) core unique to the expert; U, V shared.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind U, V once and C_e for selected experts. Path: z = V @ x, u_e = C_e @ z, y_e = U @ u_e (or fused). Three GEMVs, none of which materializes W_e. C_e stays in registers if r is small.
candidates.scar_distance: Not an unchanged archetype (the core changes per expert). Not a trivial shared basis (sandwich with a mixing core, not residual on a frozen shared W).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if g(π)=constant on held-out routes (then this collapses to the unchanged-archetype scar). Kill if mixing K archetypes cannot beat a single archetype by more than the orthogonal-null margin that already killed templates (0.0013 energy).
candidates.mechanism: route-conditioned archetypes: a small set of archetypal operators specialized by the live router score (or top-k identity), producing an adapted expert without storing a full W_e.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Bind K archetypal factors. Given router scores π, form a mixed core C(π) = sum_k g_k(π) C_k (or a sparse top-k mix) and apply C(π) @ (V @ x) natively. The kernel reads π and the archetypal factors; it does not write a dense adapted W.
candidates.scar_distance: Not an unchanged archetype: the operator depends on the live route. The named Flash route-conditioned / archetype-sparse tools are absent from this tree; this candidate is the untested structured form, not a rerun of a missing screen.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: One layer, one organ, real X (never Gaussian). Uncoded V from activation PCA; reconstruct C_e (V x) vs W_e x. Kill if output cosine is no better than an orthogonal-V control at the r the byte plan needs. If uncoded already dies, quantizing C_e cannot save it. Do not run on a specimen in this lane.
candidates.mechanism: shared input transforms: one activation-space transform z = V @ x from the real residual stream (PCA / Hessian-weighted), then expert-specific skinny maps on z. Experts may be orthogonal as W and still share input covariance.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Compute z = V @ x once per layer (serves gate+up if they share V). Selected experts apply skinny C_e to z. Down: skinny then shared U. Lookup-free GEMM. Forbidden: materialize W_e = C_e V then qmm.
candidates.scar_distance: Not trivial shared basis (activation-space V, not a shared weight basis plus residual on W). Not raw global similarity (does not use W cosine).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if a shared U at the r that saves bytes cannot match per-expert expansions on a planted sandwich; then on one layer down_proj at a later stage. Kill if combine-in-latent disagrees with expand-then-sum by more than the combiner's linearity allows (it must be identical when U is fully shared).
candidates.mechanism: shared output latent spaces: each expert emits a small latent u_e; a shared U expands to d_model. Combine can happen in the latent. Dual of shared input transforms, on the output side.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Selected experts write u_e into an r-vector. Kernel does u = sum_e π_e u_e then y = U @ u, or y_e = U @ u_e if U is only partly shared. U is bound once. Never store or form W_down,e.
candidates.scar_distance: Not a trivial shared basis (output-side only, combine-in-latent is part of the object). Not mean-expert subtraction.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Do not rerun single-tensor Kronecker at depth. Falsify the BANK decomposition: CP rank needed for a planted 3-way vs for real stack energy (later funnel). Kill if CP rank scales like E * min(d_out, d_in) (then there is no expert-mode structure).
candidates.mechanism: tensor decomposition of the expert BANK as a 3-way tensor (expert × out × in): CP / Tucker / tensor-train on the stack, consumed factor-wise.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Store CP atoms (a_r, u_r, v_r) or Tucker (G, A, U, V). Native: y = sum_r a_e,r * (u_r @ (v_r @ x)) or the Tucker contraction along in, then mix by expert row of A. Never reconstruct a dense slice W_e.
candidates.scar_distance: Not NNS-016 (that is one expert tensor, Kronecker/TT/low-rank, layers >= 1). The expert index is an additional mode.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Planted generator recovers useful tiles; real L44 bank must beat independent Q4 on held-out routed-output AND keep top-K membership. Kill if the decoder is an unconditioned shared basis in disguise.
candidates.mechanism: expert-local latent codes + shared tile decoder + route-margin repair (FLASH_META expert_bank). Share the decoder program, not a single expert basis.
candidates.native_execution_concept: route -> latent decode -> fused gate/up/SwiGLU/down accumulation. No dense W_e.
candidates.scar_distance: Not trivial shared basis (decoder is shared, codes are expert-local).

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: If a later funnel cannot even load the ROUTED_EXPERTS organ as source BF16, the school has no control. Kill the lane, not the organ.
candidates.mechanism: ROUTED_EXPERTS source tensor as LiteralTensor (analytical control).
candidates.native_execution_concept: Consume source values. No rematerialization because nothing was packed.
candidates.scar_distance: Control. Not a sharing hypothesis.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill QuantTensor as the *mission* if it is the only survivor: the school exists to find a PROGRAM, not a packing. Keep it as a control that later programs must beat on joint cost.
candidates.mechanism: ROUTED_EXPERTS independent group-64 Q4 QuantTensor control.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Packed GEMV / gather with fused dequant. Never write dense W back.
candidates.scar_distance: Independent Q4 is a control, not a Gravity program. Not uniform_subbit.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Kill if inactive experts' programs must stay resident to meet the function screen.
candidates.mechanism: Per-route executable instead of a stacked dense bank. Only selected experts' programs are live.
candidates.native_execution_concept: Gather program ids from the router; run only those subprograms.
candidates.scar_distance: Not expert merge (omitted experts stay addressable programs).

elimination.can_be_generated_predicted_or_shared: Share a decoder PROGRAM and per-expert latent codes (FLASH_META expert_bank). Do not share one weight basis. Trivial global expert sharing is dead.
elimination.dictionary_recurrent_or_conditional_expr: Route-conditioned subprograms, dictionaries with organ-tagged codebooks, and factorized one-sided subspaces remain live. Unconditioned shared codebook is dead.
elimination.function_replaceable_not_just_tensor_rep: Yes: replace per-expert dense GEMV with generated-tile GEMV / route accumulation (meta runtime_shape). Function, not tensor.
elimination.needs_independent_storage: Flattened experts look independent (L44 mean cosine ~3.8e-3, rank-1 energy ~2.7e-3). Independent STORAGE of raw W is the default; independent INFORMATION of a generator program is not.
elimination.sparse_residual_restores_capability_diff: Yes: capability-sensitive expert islands plus a sparse residual on a cheap backbone. The residual is the identity of the expert.
